title: Data Viz lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 7 comps the round-3 Data Viz templates were built and verified in: conversion funnel, bubble chart, bar chart race, stacked area chart (masked reveal), tile-grid map, icon array and calendar heatmap.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 data-viz template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a data story or infographic, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its data.
parameters: the data lists in data_viz_lab3.py (FUNNEL, BUBBLES, RACE, LAYERS, SOLAR/BINS, heat_minutes)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: All numbers are sample data, and each comp says so on screen.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (dfn_, dbc_, drc_, dsa_, dcm_, dia_, dhm_).

Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/data_viz_lab3.py; every move is baked as keys, no presets to apply; open the file, run mask.make {ids:[window, layer]} + parent.clear for the three MASKS pairs of DV Stacked area, then edit.save.
Lint: every comp 0 errors / 0 warnings (notes only on Bubble chart and Bar race: held key values).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
